description: Spends the user's Freebeat credits. quote_generation returns the current price or reports that the total is unknown. The server submits only with max_credits at or above the current quote, or with accept_unknown_cost:true when no total can be quoted. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. Use this when the user wants a photo, pet, or duet to sing a track as a short performance video. Upload images with upload_image and audio with upload_audio first, then poll get_task_status and fetch get_task_result. For lip-sync of an existing clip, use generate_lip_sync_video. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

accept_unknown_cost.description: true means the user accepted that the total is unknown; used without max_credits. Agents charge per stage; no total budget is enforced.

audio_start_seconds.description: Where in the track the performance starts.

audio_url.description: A direct audio URL. Set this or music_id, not both.

image_urls.description: Public image URLs. One for photo/pet, two different portraits for duet.

max_credits.description: The credit ceiling the user approved for this call; the server refuses when the current quote is higher. It cannot cap an unknown total or a multi-stage agent run.

mode.description: photo and pet take one image; duet takes two different portraits, one per singer.

music_id.description: An analyzed music_id from upload_audio. Set this or audio_url, not both.

remove_watermark.description: Remove the Freebeat watermark if the account allows it.

scene_prompt.description: Optional custom scene description, up to 230 characters.

name: generate_singing_video

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

status.description: The initial task status, typically pending.

task_id.description: The scoped task ID for get_task_status and get_task_result.
